ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips; estimated distribution 90% low-intensity to 10% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark pigmentation across the visible surface. High-contrast white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips. Discrete high-contrast white ring patterns (rosettes) are positioned mid-surface on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe boundary exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with approximately 9-11 distinct peaks. Right lobe boundary exhibits lower-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities transitioning to a smooth contour toward the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a convex outer edge sweep. Right lobe shows a linear-to-slightly-concave upward sweep trajectory toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonization) at the distal tips. Scattered individual white ring-shaped pixel patterns (scars) located on the interior dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation localized on the distal fluke margins. Multiple circular depigmented scars consistent with former parasitic or barnacle attachment sites are visible on the fluke's ventral surface.
